text:
marta: Heads-up: PM asked for a concise docs-runbook for the v1->v2 deprecation specifically for external customers. Need: 1) publishable banner text, 2) migration examples (py/ts/go), 3) redirect plan, 4) PR template + smoke checklist. Target publish window: 2025-05-30 morning. Who volunteers?
sam: I can take the PR template + queue labels. I'll set labels: docs-deprecate, needs-smoke, redirect-needed. Also add a GitHub action to run the link-checker on PRs touching /docs/**.yaml.
lina: I'll author the model-mapping doc. Plan to include: mapping table for common models, note about embeddings vector dimension changes (and example fallback aliases), and a short 'impact matrix' for breaking changes. Will put a draft in /docs/migration/model-mapping.md.
tony: Snippets: we need short side-by-side comparisons and a tiny 'compatibility shim' that we can show for teams that can't update immediately. Will add python + node samples and a Go snippet for completeness. Snippet note: v1 param `input: string` -> v2 `input: [{role:, content:}]` for chat style; also `client.models.invoke` renamed to `client.responses.create`.
docs-bot: automation note: remember to add redirects for /v1/**/*.md -> new locations and a banner with an opt-out link for customers on dedicated/private. We can generate redirect PRs via script once mappings are finalized.
rahul: UX/streams: streaming API framing changed; old event names `chunk` -> new event names `response.delta` etc. I will update the quickstart streaming section and run the streaming smoke harness on staging.
marta: Great. For the banner, short copy suggestion: "Deprecation Notice: The v1 API will be retired on 2025-06-01. Follow the migration guide to update your integration." Keep it one line and include link.
sam: PR template checklist (proposed): - summary + migration impact - files touched - snippets updated? (y/n) - smoke test logs (link) - redirect entries (list) - release-notes blurb (yes/no) - assign docs reviewer
I will commit templates under /.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/docs_deprecation.md and add a small workflow to tag PRs touching /docs/**.md with docs-deprecate.
lina: Model mapping quick example in one table row: gpt-old-1 -> gpt-redwood-01 (same capabilities), embed-old-512 -> embed-redwood-1024 (note: vector dim change: 512 -> 1024; we must include migration advice: reindex vectors or use alias fallback).
tony: Example snippets (inline pseudo):
```python
# v1 (old)
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hello")
# v2 (new)
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
# temporary shim
def invoke_v1_shim(client, model, input_text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model, input=[{"role":"user","content": input_text}])
```
and a short TS example for streaming changes.
rahul: I'll add the streaming event diff snippet: old SSE event `event: chunk` now `event: response.delta`, finalization event changed from `event: done` -> `event: response.complete`. Will run smoke tests and paste logs.
docs-bot: suggested automation: run a 'redirect-check' job that verifies every /v1/* page has a mapping or a banner; fail CI if unmapped and label PR as needs-redirect.
marta: Ok split work: sam = PR template + labels + automation, lina = model mapping doc + impact matrix, tony = language snippets + compat shim examples, rahul = streaming updates + smoke logs. I'll assemble a one-page playbook in /docs/deprecation/playbook.md that links to each piece and includes a short rollout checklist.
sam: I'll aim to open the PR with template and workflow by EOD. I'll add instructions in the template to include smoke test artifacts.
lina: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2505 (model mapping WIP).
tony: Snippet PR incoming; will include py/ts/go + clear temporary-shim admonition.
rahul: Streaming PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2507 - includes event name diffs and test logs.
marta: Once merged, we'll run the redirect generator and schedule the banner publish (coord with release team). Also add a short note to release notes: mention SDK rename and model swap mapping.
docs-bot: reminder set: 2025-05-28 09:00 UTC to verify redirects and banner readiness.
marta: Thanks team. Post your PR links here when ready and I'll assemble the playbook into a single PR that wires everything together. If any smoke test fails, tag #eng-oncall for help. :shipit:
